meta.geography_note: The subject parcel address and APN are intentionally withheld (privacy). All geography is reported at City of Los Angeles, Los Angeles County, Los Angeles-Long Beach-Anaheim MSA, or California level. No parcel-level value is asserted anywhere in this file.

status_definitions.verified: Value read directly from the official source listed in the source column on the access date (2026-11-08) and re-dereferenced this session.

status_definitions.flagged: Official source exists but the link or the value needs attention before reliance; see flagged.html.
